answer: Consider a random witness pool per epoch as this epoch's mechanism. Step one, each epoch assigns 7 witnesses drawn from established peers only. Step two, an answer needs 4 signatures before it reaches grading. Under the whisper rule each key funds itself, the crystal of escrow prices fakes out of the game, and the yarrow of co-signatures blocks mass farming. The cost is concrete: buying 4 witnesses under the table costs more than the 120 POA an answer can earn. Think of a jury of strangers fined for voting for your cousin. The bookkeeping is public, so anyone can audit it later.
